_doc: Factions of Night City (World.faction), from Night City 2045 (NC2045 p.32-52 and the district chapters). The gig's target faction fields the guards; others appear as third parties (bystanders, Trauma Team, NCPD, MaxTac, district security, rival crews). kind (crew/civilian/captive/corp/criminal/gang/police/service) sets defaults; relations are symmetric and resolved most-hostile-wins between kind defaults and per-faction overrides (by faction id, else by kind). leader and activities are as printed; territory is district ids (derived from docs/world/nc_*.md). roster: ranks name the NPC tiers (ours); blocks list the stat blocks (npcs.json) the faction fields per tier: its own printed NC2045 blocks, the rest core or Hardened stand-ins; a tier without blocks falls back to the tier's default pool; responder: who they send when called. look: what the view dresses them in (jacket/accent/pants/trim colours are ours, RULES-UNVERIFIED; vest/helmet/gloves; trim, else accent, is the light or coloured highlight on armbands, helmet band and pouch flaps: never near-black, and never neon or white (saturation <= 0.7, value <= 0.8; UnitLook caps an accent the same way), owner light review). gigs: the gig kinds (gigs.json templates) this faction can be the target of (ours, from activities, plus the gigs listed on places it owns; gangs never take data_theft/corp_extraction, only gangs take gang_hit). doctrine: security style (data/world/security.json). cite: where the book describes it.
